# Taiwan prototype base map

- Source: [g0v/twgeojson](https://github.com/g0v/twgeojson)
- Source file: `json/twCounty2010.geo.json`
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal
- Local transformation: main-island bounds projected to a `460 × 760` SVG and simplified for this local design prototype.

The map is only a visual itinerary aid. It is not a navigation or boundary-reference product.
